Docket No. 59611

COMMISSION STAFF’S RECOMMENDATION on administrative completeness of the application, notice and proposed procedural schedule
On April 7, 2026, El Paso Electric Company (EPE) filed an application for approval of a new tariff applicable to very large, high load factor customers. EPE proposes to create Schedule No. 27 - High Load Factor Large Power Service Rate (HLFLP) with an effective date of May 12, 2026. EPE also proposes the termination of Rate Schedule 33A upon approval of the proposed Schedule No. 27.
On May 1, 2026, the administrative law judge filed Order No. 3, requiring the Staff (Staff) of the Public Utility Commission of Texas (Commission) to file its comments and recommendations on the administrative completeness of the application and notice, and a proposal, including procedural schedule, for the appropriate processing of this docket by May 15, 2026. Therefore, this pleading is timely filed.
ADMINISTRATIVE COMPLETENESS
Staff has reviewed EPE’s application and recommends it be found sufficient. This recommendation is not a comment on the merits of the application.
SUFFICIENCY OF NOTICE
Staff has also reviewed EPE’s proposed noticed and likewise recommends it be found sufficient. 
PROPOSED PROCEDURAL SCHEDULE
In accordance with the recommendations above, Staff proposes the following procedural schedule:
CONCLUSION
Staff respectfully recommends that the application and notice be found sufficient and that the proposed procedural schedule be adopted.
Dated: May 1, 2026

Respectfully submitted,
